page.overview:
Who is Jack Stone?

The Jack Stone theme was introduced in 2001 alongside the similar theme Creator. Jack Stone acted as the basic replacement for Town Jr. and City Center's juniorization by keeping some of the previous juniorized elements as well as adding some new ones. The most notable feature of the theme was its larger, more detailed minifigures. The sets have a strong civic action theme, with Jack Stone himself acting in various roles such as a Policeman, Fireman, Worker, Coast Guard, and Pilot.

Alongside the sets, several toothbrushes and a video cassette were created based off the theme. It was initially a strong seller, but was replaced by 4+ in 2003. This theme took elements such as the adapted minifigures from Jack Stone, including the title character who appeared in several sets City subtheme albeit with a considerably reduced focus.

Jack Stone also had a major appearance at LEGOLAND Windsor Resort's LEGO City Harbour, where every day he appeared to save people trapped in a 'burning' lighthouse, zip-line out, and then douse the fire with fire hoses.
